solution.summary: In this paper, we address this issue and present a method to generate universal 3D adversarial objects to fool LiDAR detectors. We propose a universal adversarial attack on LiDAR detectors with physically realizable 3D meshes.

Introduction Modern autonomous driving systems use deep neural networks (DNNs) to process LiDAR point clouds in order to perceive the world [20, 34, 45].

The potential vulnerabilities, in conjunction with the safety-critical nature of self-driving, motivate us to investigate the possibility of disrupting autonomous driving systems with adversarial attacks.
